Confidence intervals for the maximum growth rate and its timing

Source: R/maxrate.R
confint.maxrateTMB.Rd

Wald, profile likelihood or parametric bootstrap intervals for the estimates of maxrate.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'maxrateTMB'
confint(
  object,
  parm = NULL,
  level = 0.95,
  method = c("profile", "wald", "boot"),
  nsim = 500,
  seed = NULL,
  boot = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

object

A maxrateTMB object, the result of maxrate.

parm

Character or integer vector, or NULL. Estimates, names or positions in coef(object); NULL (default) for all of them

level

Numeric between 0 and 1. The confidence level

method

Character string. "profile" for profile likelihood intervals (default), "wald" for Wald intervals, or "boot" for parametric bootstrap percentile intervals

nsim

Integer. Number of bootstrap simulations

seed

Integer or NULL. Seed for the random number generator of the bootstrap; NULL (default) sets no seed: the draws continue from the current state of the random number generator

boot

A bootstrap.gcTMB object or NULL. A bootstrap sample of the model from bootstrap, used instead of new simulations; implies method="boot". With NULL (default), method="boot" simulates nsim new bootstrap samples

...

Further arguments passed to profile.maxrateTMB or bootstrap.

Value

a matrix with the lower and upper confidence limits

Details

Profile intervals are available for tmax and rate, see maxrate; for fraction, and for tmax of a curve at its threshold, Wald intervals are returned with a message. Wald intervals use t quantiles with small-sample inference (gcTMBcontrol). Bootstrap fits whose curve has no inflection point are left out of the bootstrap intervals.

Examples

fit <- gcTMB(Height ~ DAS, data=FabaHeights25)
mr <- maxrate(fit)
confint(mr, method="wald")
#>               2.5 %     97.5 %
#> tmax     29.3846302 32.0753316
#> rate      2.3743556  2.7456798
#> fraction  0.4386425  0.4693352
confint(mr, parm=c("tmax", "rate"))
#> Computing profile confidence intervals ...
#>         2.5 %    97.5 %
#> tmax 29.43846 32.182525
#> rate  2.38040  2.752212
